job.question: What was the proposal deadline in the Hawaii ERS RFP for private equity consulting services published in 2022?
job.acceptance: Accept date/time/Hawaii Standard Time equivalents. Issue date, RFP number and later best-and-final deadline are optional context.

reviews.reason: This is a Rice University RFP for retirement-plan audit services, not the 2022 Hawaii ERS RFP for private equity consulting services. Its proposal deadline pertains to Rice University and cannot support the requested deadline.
quotes: Request for Proposal to Provide Audit Services for the William Marsh Rice University Defined Contribution Retirement Plan
Proposals must be submitted electronically, by 5:00 p.m. on Friday, January 14, 2022
